reference_scan_contract: All JSON structured string/key path references and file-like tokens in selected authored text/scripts/logs are classified. Full sources, binary images and old .lean type-formation files are opaque. Semantic citations, dynamically constructed names and unavailable truncated tool streams are explicit boundaries, not silently certified.

manual_boundaries.detail: intake_once.py references a private preservation baseline and global ledgers. Exact baseline/foreign state maps/index are prohibited. Public normal-intake-result aggregates plus target-only append leaves do not independently replace the private before-state. A sanitized separately authored attestation can describe in-place checks; it cannot fabricate missing raw history.

SG bootstrap-read-log explicitly states its initial overbroad filename-search output was truncated and unavailable; TC preliminary-read-errors preserves analogous failed tool events. Preserve these honest original addenda. No invented raw stream may be manufactured.
ROOT receipt seals log and command path, not execution-time script bytes. This allowlist hashes the current unchanged-file observation only; no retroactive execution-time hash claim is made.

Two full external source inputs and full-document layout text are verified references, default not selected. Bounded TC/SG extracts and rendered pages are individual audit leaves. Their source provenance does not silently permit packing entire source directories.

Only named old proof-free StatementFormation.lean and namespace-failed predecessor are byte-hashed opaque artifacts. New P/T production implementation paths are reference-only and never read or hashed.

Raw originals include local path strings, source excerpts, failed commands and role context. This manifest is a candidate allowlist, not public/privacy/license acceptance. ROOT selects a bounded lossless envelope after review; do not redact or project originals.
